purpose: Minimum browser handoff rules for external links surfaced by Shine applications.
rules: Only http and https URLs may be rendered as external navigation.
URLs with embedded username or password credentials are rejected.
Loopback, localhost, link-local and private-network IP destinations are rejected for public provider links.
New-tab external links isolate window.opener with noopener and should suppress referrer data.
A passing link policy does not certify the destination as reputable or scam-free; threat reputation is a separate future control.
